name: collide
meaning: bit 0 (1-byte unsigned unit): collide with the world | RCarpetMobile +0xa8, read and written as r8

name: reversed
meaning: bit 1 (1-byte unsigned unit): travelling the waypoints in reverse

name: clampEnds
meaning: bit 2 (1-byte unsigned unit): clamp at the ends (one-way)

name: driven
meaning: bit 3 (1-byte unsigned unit): driven this frame

name: snap
meaning: bit 4 (1-byte unsigned unit): snapped to a waypoint

name: arrived
meaning: bit 5 (1-byte unsigned unit): scratch: within the arrival radius
